feature_branch.description: Repo-write terminal evidence: the actual pushed feature branch, verified against the remote; null when no such evidence exists.

push_status.description: "verified" only when an independent remote readback proved the branch was pushed and matched the local final commit exactly; null when no such evidence exists.

worktree_path.description: The isolated worktree path the repo-write execution actually ran in; null when no such evidence exists.

remote_sha.description: The remote branch's SHA at readback time, proven equal to the local final commit SHA; null when no such evidence exists.

test_evidence_status.description: "reported" only when a structured test/check evidence source was actually supplied; "unknown" when repo_write_evidence exists but no such source was available (an empty `tests` list must never be read as a verified absence of tests); null when no repo_write_evidence exists at all.
